_doc: Tactics vocabulary and per-class presets (sys-tactics). Rule: IF <cond> [AND <cond>] THEN <action> ON <selector> [ONLY <pred> | PREFER <pred>] [COOLDOWN s]. First valid rule wins; the stance is the unremovable fallback.
status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (combat designer). PROPOSED · TUNABLE values; spec docs/design/_drafts/03-combat.md.

conditions.label: Always
conditions.description: Always true. Use as the last rule of a list or for abilities gated only by cooldown and focus.

conditions.label: My HP is below {pct}%
conditions.description: Own HP fraction is strictly below the threshold.

conditions.label: An ally is below {pct}% HP
conditions.description: At least one standing ally (optionally including me) is strictly below the threshold.

conditions.label: At least {count} allies are below {pct}% HP [within {band} of me]
conditions.description: Counts standing allies including me. With a band, only allies within that gap of me count.

conditions.label: An enemy is below {pct}% HP [within {band}]
conditions.description: At least one standing, targetable enemy is strictly below the threshold.

conditions.label: An enemy is within {band} range
conditions.description: Gap from me to the nearest targetable enemy is at or below the band.

conditions.label: At least {count} enemies are within {band} range
conditions.description: Surrounded test.

conditions.label: {count}+ enemies are bunched within {radiusM} m
conditions.description: Some targetable enemy has at least count-1 other enemies whose centres are within radius of its centre.

conditions.label: {count}+ allies are bunched within {radiusM} m
conditions.description: As enemies_clustered, for standing allies including me.

conditions.label: At least {count} enemies are targeting me
conditions.description: Counts enemies whose current target is me.

conditions.label: An ally [{role}] is targeted by {count}+ enemies
conditions.description: Some standing ally other than me (of that role, if given) is the current target of at least count enemies.

conditions.label: An enemy within {band} range is casting
conditions.description: A targetable enemy within the band is in an ability windup of at least 0.3 s, or channelling.

conditions.label: I have {status|category}

params.note: status id; exactly one of status or category

conditions.description: Status test on me.

conditions.label: An ally has {status|category}

params.name: status
params.note: status id; exactly one of status or category

conditions.description: Some standing ally (including me) has the status or a status of the category.

conditions.label: An enemy has {status|category} [within {band}]

params.name: status
params.note: status id; exactly one of status or category

conditions.description: Some targetable enemy has the status or category.

conditions.label: In the first {seconds} s of the round
conditions.description: Fight time strictly below the value.

conditions.label: My focus is at least {amount}
conditions.description: Own focus at or above the amount.

conditions.label: We have fewer fighters standing
conditions.description: Standing allies (including me) fewer than standing enemies.

conditions.label: At least {count} allies are down
conditions.description: Counts downed allies this round.

conditions.label: An enemy {role} is within {band} range
conditions.description: Role-based threat test (hybrids match both roles).

conditions.label: Our captain is standing
conditions.description: The acting captain (captain or, after handover, vice-captain) is standing.

selectors.label: the enemy who has dealt the most damage
the enemy attacking our weakest [{role}] ally
the enemy at the centre of the biggest group

predicates.label: in range now
predicates.description: Gap to the target is at or below the action's range (no approach).

predicates.label: within {band}
predicates.description: Gap from me to the target is at or below the band.

actions.label: Attack
actions.description: Basic-attack the target, moving into range first.

actions.label: Use {slot}
actions.description: Use the ability in that slot on the target. The pool must match the ability's target type.

actions.label: Keep away ({band})
actions.description: Keep the gap to the target above the band while basic-attacking whenever the target is in range.

actions.label: Hold position
actions.description: Do not move; basic-attack the target if in range, else the nearest enemy in range.

actions.label: Protect
actions.description: Stand between the ally and its nearest attacker and basic-attack enemies in range, preferring the ally's attackers.

actions.label: Stay with
actions.description: Move to within 2.5 m of the ally, then hold there and basic-attack enemies in range.

stances.name: Aggressive
stances.description: Attack the nearest enemy, closing in as needed.

stances.name: Steady
stances.description: Attack the nearest enemy, but do not advance more than 1 m past our frontmost ally unless an enemy is already in range.

stances.name: Cautious
stances.description: Attack the nearest enemy in range, keeping a gap of at least 60% of attack range (min 2.5 m) by backing away when closer.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Bashes casting enemies, guards the most-threatened ally, then fights the nearest enemy.

presets.name: Bodyguard
presets.summary: Stays with the healer and guards whichever ally is under attack.

presets.name: Vanguard
presets.summary: Stuns the captain's target whenever it can and guards only allies in real danger.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Rings the gong when two enemies are close, braces when hurt, and peels for allies.

presets.name: Gatekeeper
presets.summary: Moves to whichever ally is under attack and taunts the attackers off it.

presets.name: Rabble-Rouser
presets.summary: Charges into the enemy back line and taunts it from the inside.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Cleaves whatever is in front of it and takes a second wind below half HP.

presets.name: Bloodied Line
presets.summary: Pushes into the captain's target and only stops to heal when nearly down.

presets.name: Hold the Line
presets.summary: Heals early and fights whoever attacks the healer.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Bristles when focused, scatters caltrops when crowded, and stands in the way.

presets.name: Briar Wall
presets.summary: Plants itself beside threatened allies so attackers must go through the barbs.

presets.name: Spitebait
presets.summary: Walks into the enemy's top damage dealer and dares it to keep swinging.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Parries when two enemies swing at it and provokes anyone hitting the healer.

presets.name: Duelist
presets.summary: Picks the enemy's top damage dealer, provokes it and parries its blows.

presets.name: Escort
presets.summary: Shadows the most-threatened ally and provokes its attackers.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Locks shields when nearby allies are hurt and pikes back anyone in reach.

presets.name: Shield Wall
presets.summary: Holds beside the healer, shields early and pikes away divers.

presets.name: Advance
presets.summary: Marches on the captain's target behind its pike, shielding only when the line is hurt.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Finishes wounded enemies, otherwise steps onto the back line once it is within reach.

presets.name: Healer Hunter
presets.summary: Goes straight for the enemy healer and stays on it.

presets.name: Counter-Diver
presets.summary: Hunts whoever is attacking our back line.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Frenzies once in melee and keeps rending the nearest enemy.

presets.name: Red Mist
presets.summary: Saves the frenzy until it is already hurt, then follows the captain's target.

presets.name: Leashed
presets.summary: Frenzies to survive and fights only enemies that attack its allies.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Flurries whatever it is fighting and sidesteps when two enemies close in.

presets.name: Focus Fire
presets.summary: Locks onto the captain's target to keep its momentum.

presets.name: Guard Dance
presets.summary: Sidesteps early and flurries enemies who attack its allies.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Sunders what it fights, beheads anything below 30% nearby, and swings Behead whenever focus is high.

presets.name: Reaper
presets.summary: Hunts wounded enemies anywhere and follows the captain's target otherwise.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Leaps on clusters of three and spins when two enemies are close.

presets.name: Thresher
presets.summary: Leaps on any pair it can reach and spins at first contact.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Lunges at enemy casters mid-spell, otherwise bursts runes on whoever is close.

presets.name: Mage Hunter
presets.summary: Dives the enemy healer, then controllers.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Leaps away from anyone who gets close and aims at the weakest enemy in range.

presets.name: Headhunter
presets.summary: Aims at the enemy healer first, then the furthest enemy it can hit.

presets.name: Overwatch
presets.summary: Shoots whatever is attacking our allies.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Tumbles away from melee, pins chasers, and shoots the captain's target while kiting.

presets.name: Run and Gun
presets.summary: Pins and shoots the lowest-HP enemy, tumbling only when caught.

presets.name: Escort Fire
presets.summary: Pins enemies attacking allies and shoots them.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Blooms fire on any two bunched enemies and lances the nearest.

presets.name: Inferno
presets.summary: Blooms fire on the densest group whenever it can and lances the weakest enemy.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Ruptures fully poisoned enemies, clouds bunched enemies, and spreads poison to fresh targets.

presets.name: Plague Doctor
presets.summary: Clouds the enemy healer and ruptures anything carrying two stacks.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Claps back anyone in melee range and chains lightning off the nearest enemy.

presets.name: Storm Front
presets.summary: Chains lightning into the densest group and finishes the weakest enemy.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Keeps a writ on the captain's target, nets anyone who closes in, and shoots the marked enemy.

presets.name: Bounty Board
presets.summary: Marks the enemy healer and focuses whatever is marked.

presets.name: Warden's Writ
presets.summary: Nets and marks enemies that attack our allies.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Roots anyone who closes in and lances the nearest enemy.

presets.name: Ice Wall
presets.summary: Lances enemies attacking the healer and roots crowds around itself.

presets.name: Lockdown
presets.summary: Slows the captain's target and roots crowds.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Withers the enemy's top damage dealer and curses bunched enemies.

presets.name: Ruin
presets.summary: Curses the captain's target first, then withers the top damage dealer.

presets.name: Ward-Hex
presets.summary: Withers whoever is hurting a badly wounded ally.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Blows away anyone who gets close and pulls bunched enemies together.

presets.name: Windbreak
presets.summary: Blasts enemies away and slows anyone attacking allies.

presets.name: Vortex
presets.summary: Drags groups of three together for allied area damage.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Hushes any enemy cast it can see and unravels buffed enemies.

presets.name: Gag Order
presets.summary: Keeps the enemy healer silenced, then controllers, and unravels the captain's target.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Sleeps an enemy no ally is attacking, preferring the healer, and dazes bunched enemies.

presets.name: Lullaby
presets.summary: Dazes enemies piling on an ally and sleeps whoever attacks it.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Traps anyone who gets close, tars bunched enemies, and traps attackers of allies.

presets.name: Hunting Ground
presets.summary: Traps and tars the captain's target.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Cleanses stunned allies, sutures anyone below 70%, and cleanses heavy debuffs.

presets.name: Triage
presets.summary: Saves focus for emergencies: sutures below 40% first, tops up only with spare focus, and stays near the tank.

presets.name: Combat Medic
presets.summary: Heals only below 50% and otherwise joins the captain's attack.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Sings when two nearby allies are hurt, sanctifies the weakest ally, and stays near the group.

presets.name: Choir Circle
presets.summary: Stays in the middle of the group and sings early.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Shields the ally under the most attackers, then the weakest ally, and lattices a hurt group.

presets.name: Pre-emptive
presets.summary: Opens with a lattice and keeps a barrier on the tank.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Keeps rejuvenation on hurt allies and blooms when three are hurt.

presets.name: Evergreen
presets.summary: Keeps the tank permanently rejuvenated, then everyone else.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Wards allies about to fall and mends anyone below 70%.

presets.name: Watchful
presets.summary: Wards whichever ally two enemies are attacking, and mends early.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Drums once the fighting starts, rallies when two are hurt or anyone is rooted, and stays with the group.

presets.name: Charge Beat
presets.summary: Drums from the opening and pushes forward with the tank.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Hardens below half HP and charges the weakest enemy within reach.

presets.name: Gatecrasher
presets.summary: Charges the furthest enemy it can reach, then fights the weakest one nearby.

presets.name: Breakwater
presets.summary: Charges enemies off allies and hardens early.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Plants when two enemies focus it, shoves melee attackers, and shoots the nearest enemy.

presets.name: Battery
presets.summary: Plants as soon as enemies are in range and shoots the weakest one.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Stomps when two enemies are close and shackles whatever it fights.

presets.name: Warden of the Line
presets.summary: Shackles enemies attacking allies and stays beside the threatened ally.

presets.name: Lockup
presets.summary: Shackles the captain's target and stomps on contact.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Harpoons the furthest enemy it can reach and slams the nearest.

presets.name: Lifeline
presets.summary: Harpoons enemies off the healer, then off anyone else.

presets.name: Catch of the Day
presets.summary: Hauls in the enemy healer, or failing that a ranged enemy.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Lays hands on allies below 50% and consecrates when two enemies are close.

presets.name: Oathkeeper
presets.summary: Stays beside the most-threatened ally and heals early.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Takes root when two nearby allies are hurt and lashes enemies in reach.

presets.name: Grove Guard
presets.summary: Stays beside the healer and takes root when the group is hurt.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Nets the nearest enemy, preferring ranged ones, then lunges at whatever is in reach.

presets.name: Retiarius
presets.summary: Nets and lunges at the captain's target.

presets.name: Net Guard
presets.summary: Nets enemies attacking the healer, then lunges at anyone attacking allies.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Cracks any casting enemy, sprays anyone who closes in, and stuns the top damage dealer.

presets.name: Headcracker
presets.summary: Stuns the captain's target and sprays bunched enemies.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Mists when two nearby allies are hurt and siphons whatever is in reach.

presets.name: Bloodletter
presets.summary: Mists in crowds and siphons the weakest enemy nearby.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Mends allies below 50% and brands the captain's target.

presets.name: Dawnkeeper
presets.summary: Heals first, and brands only enemies that attack allies.

presets.name: Zealot
presets.summary: Brands and burns the captain's target, healing only emergencies.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Washes stunned allies clean, floods bunched enemies, and heals hurt groups.

presets.name: Riptide Guard
presets.summary: Floods enemies piling on an ally and heals early.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.summary: Rewinds allies below 50% and mires bunched enemies or the top damage dealer.

presets.name: Second Chances
presets.summary: Rewinds early and mires enemies piling on an ally.
